correctness.rationale: Fixed h>=1 and named distance levels R_i on leaves of uniform rooted prefix tree with b_i>=2. For differing truncated branch values min(b_i,k), the existential sentence requiring t=b_i+1<=k leaves pairwise at R_i distinguishes precisely a smaller branching level; t points at common level-i parent must occupy distinct i children. If all min(b_i,k) agree, each partial distance-preserving correspondence of fewer than k pebbled leaves extends after any Spoiler move: occupied child prefixes map identically and a new unused child exists on both sides whenever needed because occupied child count<k, with exact agreement if b_i<k. This gives Duplicator every finite k-pebble game, hence unrestricted rank FO^k equivalence. There are (k-1)^h truncation vectors; sharp maximum smallest representative k^h, minimal separating variable width min_i:bi!=ci (min(bi,ci)+1). Counting C² annulus sizes N_i=(b_i-1) product_{j>i} b_j, recovered bottom-up. Independent enumeration tested the full two-way extension signature property for 12,784 compatible partial isometries across four (b,c,k) pairs with differing underlying tree sizes; all passed.
